<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1790229_event_ma.GetEventDetails</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><name>GetEventDetails</name><script><![CDATA[var GetEventDetails = Class.create();
GetEventDetails.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

   getEventInfo: function() {
        var eventId = this.getParameter('sysparm_event_id');

        var eventRec = new GlideRecord('x_1790229_event_ma_event_record');
        if (eventRec.get(eventId)) {
            var data = {
                event_name: eventRec.getValue('u_event_name'),
                event_date: eventRec.getValue('u_event_date'),
                location: eventRec.getValue('u_location'),
                status: eventRec.getValue('u_status')
            };
            return new JSON.encode(data);
        }
        return '';
   },
    type: 'GetEventDetails'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-08-04 09:16:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>495f5ddb83072210041ec170deaad31b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GetEventDetails</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Event Management &Planning system" source="x_1790229_event_ma">e95a389783432210041ec170deaad3d2</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Event Management &Planning system">e95a389783432210041ec170deaad3d2</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_495f5ddb83072210041ec170deaad31b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-08-04 09:16:19</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
